claims.statement: PV loss can be expressed in reduced energy production, and IEA PVPS describes monitoring, forecasting, analysis, and performance indicators as O&M functions; applicability and loss magnitude for small Polish commercial sites require measurement.
The intended budget owner is the party already accountable for generation or O&M performance, but a distinct monitoring budget and the proposed price are unverified.
Control is obtainable only through explicit data-rights agreements; the family operating relationship can introduce the request but creates no telemetry entitlement.
URE's reported installed base confirms many potential monitored assets but does not identify commercial sites, telemetry availability, or willingness to pay.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Asset manager, facilities lead, or O&M service owner
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Neutral cross-vendor normalization and portfolio-level loss prioritization must justify paying alongside bundled monitoring
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Each installer or O&M firm retains its asset-owner relationship; founder company owns direct monitoring contracts it signs
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Separately authorized pilot request through the operating relationship, followed by O&M partnerships and direct commercial-owner sales

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Founder-led O&M partnerships and portfolio-owner outbound; target CAC recovery within six months, unvalidated
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Monthly advance billing or annual prepayment; enterprise procurement may extend collection
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Target 75-90% at stable connectors; unvalidated and sensitive to integration support
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Connector setup, data-quality exceptions, alert calibration, and monthly reports
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Data-rights contracts, security, hosting, professional liability, and vendor API maintenance
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 49-149 PLN per site per month with a 1000 PLN portfolio minimum
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Telemetry ingestion, weather data, compute, notifications, and limited analyst review

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Inverter OEMs and monitoring portals can add richer alerts or cross-sell service contracts
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Underperformance is measurable as weather- and system-adjusted lost kilowatt-hours and can trigger an O&M investigation or service visit
commercial_mechanics.payer: Commercial PV owner or contracted O&M provider
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Unexplained bill or yield variance, missed inverter alarms, or a portfolio crossing a manual-monitoring threshold
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Monthly or annual monitoring renewal per connected site

contrary_evidence: Most inverter platforms already include alerts and dashboards in the equipment price.
The IEA PVPS soiling-loss figures are global and strongly weighted toward larger or different-climate systems, not proof of Polish small-site loss.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Nonexclusive 12-month data-rights and processing agreement allowing site monitoring and de-identified aggregate feature creation
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Use unrelated owners, inverter exports, and public weather inputs; exclude any site without proven authorization
critical_control_point.current_owner: Each asset owner or its monitoring provider owns or controls source telemetry; no family-firm data is presumed
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Each installer or O&M firm retains its asset-owner relationship; founder company owns direct monitoring contracts it signs
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: The parents' firm provides only a lawful route to ask for a pilot. Telemetry, customer identities, sites, and contracts remain unavailable unless the independent firm and relevant asset owners expressly authorize them.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Founder company only after each owner or authorized operator signs and supplies credentials or exports
critical_control_point.renewal: Annual opt-in renewal with deletion and export terms
critical_control_point.subject: Permissioned multi-vendor PV telemetry panel and derived de-identified benchmark features

economics.acquisition_route: Authorized operating-relationship pilot request, then O&M channel agreements and direct portfolio sales
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Illustrative, not forecast: 15000 sites at an 80 PLN blended monthly fee imply 14.4m PLN annual recurring revenue; a defensible benchmark dataset and low churn would still be necessary for a 5m PLN founder outcome
economics.founder_time: Up to five hours daily during connector build and pilots, falling with automated data QA and scheduled support
economics.gross_margin_basis: Automated ingestion and anomaly scoring with analyst review only for high-value exceptions
economics.payback: Target under six months of gross profit per account; unvalidated
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 49-149 PLN per site monthly, subject to a 1000 PLN portfolio minimum
economics.retention_or_repeat: Recurring while connectors remain reliable and documented recoverable yield exceeds subscription cost

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A permissioned cross-vendor panel improves expected-yield curves and failure triage as site-months accumulate
fingerprint.customer: Independent PV operations firms and owners of small commercial photovoltaic portfolios
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Request a rights-limited pilot through the family installer relationship, then acquire separate data-rights agreements from unrelated owners and O&M firms
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Vendor-neutral yield normalization, loss estimates, prioritized alerts, and monthly O&M evidence sold as recurring data intelligence
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Portfolio owner or O&M provider pays per monitored site each month after connecting consented telemetry
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Actual generation diverges from weather-adjusted expectations without a clear alert or cross-vendor benchmark

founder_fit: Time-series anomaly detection and causal triage align with the founder's data-science background
The system has measurable outputs in lost kilowatt-hours, alert precision, and resolution time
A relationship-based pilot can be requested lawfully without assuming any customer or data ownership
Automated monitoring can fit a sub-five-hour daily founder schedule
risks: False alerts can generate unnecessary truck rolls and erode trust
Vendor API withdrawal could strand connectors
Rights to derived benchmarks may be contested without precise contracts
Early portfolios may be too heterogeneous for useful comparison

structure.commercial_archetype: Recurring performance-intelligence subscription per authorized site
structure.control_point: Contractual rights to normalize and compare telemetry from a replaceable multi-owner site panel
structure.critical_dependency: Continued owner-authorized telemetry access of adequate quality

thesis: Secure owner-authorized, vendor-neutral telemetry rights for a replaceable portfolio of small commercial PV sites and sell installers an anomaly and peer-benchmark feed tied to measurable lost kilowatt-hours.
title: Consent-Based PV Yield Anomaly Panel
uncertainties: Accessible telemetry depth and connector stability across inverter brands
Minimum site count needed for a credible local benchmark
Ability to distinguish curtailment, weather, shading, and hardware faults
Who pays when owner and O&M incentives differ
